The write-side counterpart introduced by this delta — `ciRunsToRerun` in `scripts/agent/checks.mjs:121`, plus the two inline mirrors in `.github/workflows/agent-rerun.yml:186-207` and `.github/workflows/agent-loop.yml:142-163` — is documented only in code comments and in `docs/tasks/active/20260825-promote-exit-code-default-lessons.md:75-91`.
